Repository: tcp_chat
What the code contains: `tcp_chat` is a Python project with 3 module(s), a command line (`client.py`) and 1 test file(s).
Summary of the code: The tcp_chat repository implements a Python-based chat system composed of three core modules and a test suite using pytest. The underlying communication rules are defined in protocol.py::protocol.py through a line protocol with commands and length-prefixed frames. The server operations are handled by server.py::server.py, which uses a threaded TCP architecture to manage unique nicknames and broadcast messages across clients, while client.py::client.py serves as the command-line chat client.
Declared dependencies: pytest
Entry points: client.py, server.py

Write the opening paragraph of the README (2-4 sentences): what the project does and for whom. Use only these facts; do not name any technology, command, port or file that is not listed above.

The `tcp_chat` repository provides a multi-client chat system designed for users who need a lightweight, Python-based messaging setup. It includes a dedicated server that manages unique user nicknames and broadcasts messages, alongside a command-line client for real-time interaction. Powered by a custom line protocol with length-prefixed frames, the system also features a complete test suite using pytest to ensure reliable message delivery across connected clients.
